title: Shepard tone (pitch up)
description: Shepard Tone (Pitch Up) is a small client-side sound mod. When the same sounds play repeatedly in a short time, their pitch rises step by step, making repeated actions feel more lively.
body:
# What is Shepard tone?
A Shepard tone is a auditory illusion that creates the feeling of a sound continually ascending or descending in pitch, while in reality, its actual frequency is looped and never rises above a certain limit (This exact trick was used for the endless stairs in Super Mario 64)

# Why did you used pitch up and not shepard tone?
This trick can only be pulled off with fixed wave timings, which is why it cannot be done in a live game but I tried to replicate the effect anyway just by pitching up individual sounds



A similar [mod](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2196484541) already exists for The Binding of Isaac, which is where I got the idea from. All credit for the original concept goes to [IsaacGuru](https://steamcommunity.com/id/OciXCrom)
